extracted.name: Pear and Pomegranate Salad
extracted.description: This colorful pear and pomegranate salad is garnished with juicy pomegranate arils and dressed with a warm pomegranate vinaigrette.
ingredient_lines: 3 cups green leaf lettuce, rinsed and torn
instruction_lines: Divide lettuce, pear slices, and pomegranate seeds between two bowls and mix gently.

Combine vegetable oil, pomegranate juice, lemon juice, mustard, honey, and pepper in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until dressing thickens slightly, about 2 minutes. Pour warm dressing over salads and serve.
